description: This file defines a utility class for managing EntityManager instances in a Spring and JPA-based application. It provides methods for opening and closing EntityManagers, primarily used for testing purposes.

classes.name: EntityManagerUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling EntityManager instances, providing methods to open, close, and retrieve the EntityManager, specifically for testing scenarios.

methods.name: openEntityManager
methods.description: Opens or retrieves an existing EntityManager, binding it to the transaction if necessary.

methods.name: closeEntityManager
methods.description: Closes the EntityManager and unbinds it from the transaction if it is bound.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the current EntityManager instance injected by Spring.
